title: KHR_audio_rigid_bodies glTF Node Extension
description: Makes this node's rigid body participate in physically based contact sound, as a sounding body, a contact surface, or both.

modalModel.description: The index of the modal model in the top level `modalModels` array instanced by this node.

acousticSurface.description: The index of the acoustic surface in the top level `acousticSurfaces` array describing the finish of this node's surface.
acousticSurface.gltf_detailedDescription: A node MAY supply an acoustic surface without a modal model, which lets a silent body such as a floor contribute its finish to the sound of a contact against it.

gain.description: Linear amplitude scale applied to this instance's output.
